title: Capy Kingdom Beginner Tips: Your First Day, Step by Step
subtitle: What to tap, what to ignore and when to come back, from the developer.
description: Capy Kingdom beginner tips from the developer: what to upgrade first, how bosses and the stage timer work, and how offline earnings keep growing your kingdom.
card: Capy Kingdom beginner tips for your first day: the three upgrade cards, why a boss loss is not a setback, and how to use offline earnings.

faq.q: What should I do first in Capy Kingdom?
faq.a: Spend coins on Power, Speed and Money, equip the first weapon and pet you get, and keep playing. The capybara fights on its own, so the early game is mostly about buying upgrades and collecting your first items.

faq.q: What happens if I lose to a boss?
faq.a: You are not stuck. The game drops you back to farm the step before the boss, where you keep earning coins. When you are stronger, you try the boss again. The game also shows how much stronger you need to be.

faq.q: Do I need to play for hours each day?
faq.a: No. Sessions are short by design, and the kingdom pays coins while the game is closed. A few minutes to spend coins, claim the Diamond Spring and start a pet trip is a good daily routine.
